note: Ordinary single-column body page: one 'full' column, prose measure x0.312-0.904, with the worked-example panel's blue side tab hanging left to x0.264, which is why the column is declared from 0.26. body_text_size_px measured as cap-to-baseline on the top prose paragraph (block 1), ~21 px at this render (1700x2178, approx 205 dpi). Block n values were matched purely by POSITION against the supplied block list, which runs in the page's reading order and is confirmed by each text_head; no earlier numbering was used. Worked-example panel measured as distinct elements per instruction: the grey panel fill (role box, n null, #dadada, x0.313-0.886, y0.291-0.859) and the rotated side tab (role marginal_note, the cyan #29abe2 vertical bar at x0.264-0.301) are separate, and the panel's thin cyan right-hand border stripe is a third element. The tab's rotated 'EXAMPLE 1.13' label occupies only the bar's lower portion, about y0.77-0.86, and is set in dark serif small caps on the cyan, not reversed white; the bar's bbox is the whole tab. The panel's contents (blocks 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7) are listed as separate elements inside it and each carries the panel's #dadada as its fill. Two rule_bar elements appear, both cyan #29abe2: the cyan underline beneath the top page_header_band, and the panel's right-hand stripe; neither is a chapter-opening divider, they are simply plain coloured bands with no text on a body page, and they do not conflict with the page_header_band's own pale cyan #cde9f7. The 'FIGURE 1.32' caption is given n null because block 3 is a figure with an empty text_head and I cannot tell whether A2 folded the caption into it; a wrong match there would misplace text. The '2022-23' edition line at the page foot is reported as running_header because the allowed role list has no running-footer value; it is a foot-of-page publishing mark, not a header. The page_number fill #d3e5ef was sampled from the small flat interior of its tint box and is the least certain colour on the page.
